definitions.explanation: A painting or drawing whose subject is natural scenery such as mountains, rivers, fields, or townscapes.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}に{風景画|ふうけいが}を{飾|かざ}った。
examples.english: I hung a landscape painting on the wall.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{風景画|ふうけいが}を{描|か}くのが{得意|とくい}だ。
examples.english: She is good at painting landscapes.

examples.japanese: この{美術館|びじゅつかん}には、{有名|ゆうめい}な{画家|がか}の{風景画|ふうけいが}が{数多|かずおお}く{展示|てんじ}されている。
examples.english: This art museum exhibits many landscape paintings by famous painters.

notes:
Compound of {風景|ふうけい} (scenery, landscape) + {画|が} (picture, painting). The {画|が} suffix names a genre of picture, as in {肖像画|しょうぞうが} (portrait) and {静物画|せいぶつが} (still life).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風景画|ふうけいが}を{描|か}く: to paint a landscape
- {風景画|ふうけいが}を{飾|かざ}る: to display a landscape painting
- {水彩|すいさい}の{風景画|ふうけいが}: a watercolor landscape

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肖像画|しょうぞうが}: portrait — a picture whose subject is a person
- {山水画|さんすいが}: ink landscape painting — a traditional East Asian style of mountains and water
